Narnia · 02
Start with one fact
What could come next?

One fact is good. What related fact could we add?

Gryphons live in the snow-covered forests of Narnia.
They guard hidden treasure.They build nests on cliffs.They have powerful wings.

All three ideas stay focused on gryphons.

Narnia · 03
Connect the facts
Watch the writer build

Adding-on words create a clear connection.

Gryphons live in the snow-covered forests.
+
They guard hidden treasure.
Gryphons live in the snow-covered forests. Additionally, they guard hidden treasure.
Narnia · 04
Read like a writer
Find the toolkit

What job does the highlighted word perform?

Many ordinary animals can be found throughout Narnia.

Additionally, visitors may be lucky enough to spot a gryphon or even a minotaur in the snow-covered forests.

It adds another fact.
The new fact is related.
A comma follows the starter.

Narnia · 06
Check your groups
Different words, different jobs

Adding-on words keep building the same topic.

Adds another fact

also

additionally

moreover

furthermore

in addition

Does a different job

because

however

therefore

although

as a result

The second group is useful too — but those words do not simply add information.
Narnia · 07
Sentence patterns
Two useful positions

Where should the adding-on word go?

Additionally,

Additionally, phoenixes can heal injuries with their tears.

It begins the sentence, so it is followed by a comma.

also

Phoenixes also produce an extraordinary amount of heat.

It sits inside the sentence. It does not need a comma.
